title: gke-xpk-training vars
description: Variables for GKE XPK distributed ML training stack

XPK_CLUSTER_NAME.description: Name of the Google Kubernetes Engine XPK cluster

GCP_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID where the cluster is created

GCP_ZONE.description: Google Cloud Zone for the XPK cluster (e.g. us-central2-b)

TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE.description: TPU accelerator type for the training nodes (e.g. v4-8, v5e-16)

WORKLOAD_NAME.description: Identifier for the training workload job

TRAIN_SCRIPT.description: Command or script executed inside the training container

DOCKER_IMAGE.description: Docker container image containing training code and dependencies
